lines.text: Many learners say: After my opinion, it is good.
Better: In my opinion, it is good.
In! In my opinion, it is good.

data.wrong: After my opinion, it is good.
data.right: In my opinion, it is good.

native.tip: Im Deutschen heißt es „nach meiner Meinung“. Im Englischen sagen Sie „in my opinion“, nicht „after“.

en.tip: German says “nach meiner Meinung”. In English you say “in my opinion”, not “after”.
en.caption: “Nach” here is “in”, not “after”! Wrong: “After my opinion, it is good.” Right: “In my opinion, it is good.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
